segments.name: net advertising services
segments.description: Earns advertising revenue from advertising clients who place advertising on its content platforms.
segments.evidence: The Group currently operates in two principal operating segments: net advertising services and paid services.

segments.name: paid services
segments.description: Earns revenue from paid content and E-commerce and other services on its platforms.
segments.evidence: Our paid services revenues comprise (i) revenues from paid contents and (ii) revenues from E-commerce and others, contributing 90.4% and 9.6% of our paid services revenues in 2025, respectively.

revenueModel.text: Advertising clients pay for advertising placed on the platforms; paid services earn revenue from paid content and E-commerce.
revenueModel.evidence: In 2025, we generated revenues from advertising and paid services, which accounted for 80.2% and 19.8% of our total revenues, respectively.
